Developers/Programmers (Information & Communication Technology)

Quick apply
About Francom
Francom is a leading financial services organisation committed to delivering secure, reliable, and compliant technology solutions while maintaining the highest standards of governance. Guided by our core values — Leadership, Integrity, Excellence, Balance, and Nurturing (LIEBN) — we support our clients and teams through innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Junior to Mid-Level Software Developer to join our growing technology team. This is a full-stack, on-site role based in our Parramatta office, ideal for a developer with 1–3 years of professional experience who is keen to build secure, scalable web-based platforms in a collaborative Agile environment.

You will be involved in the design, development, and maintenance of internal CRM systems and public-facing websites, working closely with other developers, QA, and stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Front-End Development
  • Build responsive, user-friendly interfaces using React, Redux, and TypeScript
  • Implement modern UI components and styling using Material UI (MUI)
Back-End Development
  • Develop and maintain .NET Core Web APIs and server-side logic using C#
  • Implement background processing and scheduled jobs using Hangfire
Database
  • Design and maintain relational databases using Microsoft SQL Server
  • Write, optimise, and maintain T-SQL stored procedures
  • Use Redgate tools to manage database migrations across environments
Project & Delivery
  • Use Azure DevOps for task tracking, CI/CD pipelines, and release management
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including stand-ups, sprint planning, handovers, and retrospectives
Testing & Quality
  • Test your own code thoroughly and participate in peer code reviews
  • Work closely with QA to diagnose and resolve defects efficiently
General
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders
  • Take a proactive, professional approach to work and problem-solving
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and development best practices
  • Identify, mitigate, and prevent code-based security vulnerabilities
What We’re Looking For
  • 1–3 years of professional experience as a software developer
  • Strong skills in React, TypeScript, and .NET Core (C#)
  • Experience working with SQL Server and T-SQL
  • Familiarity with Agile development practices
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively on-site in a team environment
  • Commitment to secure coding and quality outcomes
  • Alignment with Francom’s LIEBN values
Nice to Have (Not Essential)
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure (App Service, API Management, Azure Functions, Storage, Application Insights)
  • Experience integrating with third-party APIs
  • Familiarity with Node.js or WordPress
  • Experience securing applications using Cloudflare, including reverse proxy services, WAF rules, and Zero Trust policies
Why Join Us
  • Competitive Salary
  • Work on meaningful, real-world systems in a regulated environment
  • Collaborative, supportive, and technically capable team
  • Exposure to modern tools, cloud technologies, and secure application design
  • Opportunity to grow your technical skills and career within a stable organisation
Apply Now
If you are a motivated developer looking to grow your skills in a professional, on-site Agile environment, we would love to hear from you.
Please apply via Seek, including your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your experience and interest in the role.
